group.description:
Scholarlydata takes care of the refactoring of the Semantic Web Dog Food (SWDF), in an effort to keep the dataset growing in good health. We use a novel data model, the conference-ontology, which improves the Semantic Web Conference Ontology, adopting best ontology design practices.

All the current data can be accessed in different formats (i.e., HTML, RDF/XML, Turtle, N-TRIPLES, and JSON-LD) via URI dereferencing, queried via SPARQL or downloaded as single RDF dumps for each conference and workshop.

package.name: scholarlydata
package.author: Andrea Giovanni Nuzzolese, Anna Lisa Gentile
package.notes: The Semantic Web Dog Food (SWDF)i s the reference linked dataset of the Semantic Web community about papers, people, organisations, and events related to its academic conferences. Scholarlydata dataset (https://w3id.org/scholarlydata) is a refactoring of SWDF. We use a novel data model (conference-ontology) which improves the Semantic Web Conference Ontology, adopting best ontology design practices. To add conference to this dataset we provide an open source maintenance workflow https://github.com/AnLiGentile/cLODg
